common_instructions: Use case: precise-object-edit. Produce ONE individual football jersey RGB template. IMAGE 1 IS THE EDIT TARGET: keep exactly this white shirt's front view, outer silhouette, shape, proportions, sleeve shape, collar, seams, fabric texture, folds, illumination and framing. IMAGE 2 IS THE COLOR-REGION MAP: transfer its red, green and blue areas faithfully onto the corresponding anatomical areas of the white shirt. Match stripe/band count, relative widths, positions, direction, sleeve panels, thin pinlines and trim to IMAGE 2. Use primary RED #FF0000, GREEN #00FF00 and BLUE #0000FF; preserve realistic shaded fabric by varying intensity within those primary channels. Do not use the small mask's shape or low-resolution pixelation. Do not add or swap color zones. Do not arbitrarily make cuff trim blue if the mask shows another color there. Actual transparent background. Remove ALL detached speckles around the shirt, including above collar and below hem; clean softly antialiased silhouette, no halo. One shirt only, no text, numbering, logos, watermark, border, collage or extra objects. Preserve the white model's design and geometry.
